Insecure QuickSight Dashboard Access Control [Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-284] on QuickSight Dashboard, S3 Data Lake, Timestream Database: QuickSight uses IAM roles and its own permission system for dashboard access. Misconfiguration can grant excessive permissions to users or groups. A user with basic QuickSight access could potentially view dashboards containing sensitive data from other business units due to overly permissive sharing settings.

Insufficient Audit Logging [Repudiation, CWE-778] on API Gateway, Lambda Functions, Kinesis Analytics, OpenSearch Domain, QuickSight Dashboard: While basic CloudWatch logging is enabled, detailed audit trails of user actions, data access, and system changes are not comprehensively captured across all services. An attacker could perform unauthorized actions without detection, or clean up traces of their activities due to insufficient logging.

Insecure API Gateway Configuration [Spoofing, Tampering, Information Disclosure, CWE-306] on API Gateway, WAF, Lambda Functions: The API Gateway configuration lacks comprehensive authentication mechanisms and rate limiting, potentially allowing API abuse. An attacker could perform credential stuffing attacks or abuse API endpoints due to insufficient rate limiting and authentication controls.

Vulnerable Data Processing Pipeline [Tampering, Denial of Service, CWE-74] on Kinesis Data Streams, Kinesis Analytics, Lambda Functions, EventBridge: Data ingested through Kinesis streams could contain malicious payloads that might exploit vulnerabilities in processing logic. An attacker could inject malformed data that crashes processing functions or manipulates analytics results.

EMR Cluster Security Vulnerabilities [Elevation of Privilege, Information Disclosure, CWE-732] on EMR Cluster, VPC, S3 Data Lake: EMR clusters running in the VPC could be vulnerable to unauthorized access or privilege escalation if security groups and IAM roles are not properly configured. An attacker with access to the VPC could potentially access the EMR cluster and execute unauthorized analytics jobs.
